title.description: Title of this page, used in metadata and route navigation.
title.markdownDescription:
```yaml
page:
  title: About
```

The page title used in metadata and route navigation.

[Page frontmatter reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.16/docs/content.md#page-frontmatter)

description.markdownDescription:
```yaml
page:
  description: About this project.
```

An optional page-specific description rendered as `<meta name="description">`. It is not visible in page content.

[Page frontmatter reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.16/docs/content.md#page-frontmatter)

page.description: Metadata for this homepage or route.
page.markdownDescription:
```yaml
page:
  title: About
  description: About this project.
```

Contains metadata for the current homepage or route.

[Page frontmatter reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.16/docs/content.md#page-frontmatter)

navigation.description: Optional navigation metadata for this page.

listed.description: List this route in site navigation. The route remains public when false.
listed.markdownDescription:
```yaml
navigation:
  listed: false
```

List this route in site navigation. The route remains public when false.

[Read the relevant reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.16/docs/routes.md#navigation)

navigation.markdownDescription:
```yaml
navigation:
  listed: false
```

Optionally excludes a route from site navigation without removing its public URL.

[Route navigation reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.16/docs/routes.md#navigation)

description: Frontmatter for a homepage or route content.md file.
title: Norna page frontmatter
markdownDescription:
```yaml
---
page:
  title: About
  description: About this project.
---
```

Every homepage and route `content.md` starts with page metadata, followed by Markdown sections.

[Page frontmatter reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.16/docs/content.md#page-frontmatter)
